resources.string: "Add an HTTPS subscription. Preview before applying. Failed downloads preserve your profiles. Updates require a disconnected VPN."
"Checked about every 12 hours when the network and battery allow. Removals require review. Locally edited profiles are preserved."
"Incoming profiles: %1$d. Removed from source: %2$d. Applying preserves local edits. Profiles removed by the source are kept in a local collection; refresh never deletes them."
"Use a valid HTTPS URL without embedded login details or a fragment."
"Empty, incomplete or unsupported subscription. Existing profiles were preserved."
"Disconnect the VPN before applying subscription changes."
"The source removed profiles. Review the update manually."
"The source changed during review. Fetch a new preview."
"Could not update this subscription. Check the source, network and saved credentials. Existing profiles were preserved."
"This collection is too large for a readable QR code. Use file export instead; no profiles were omitted."
"Top layer reaches the Internet. Bottom layer receives your apps."
"Rovunet Lite is a lightweight version with a smaller app size."
"How would you like to share the app?"
"Are you sure you want to delete "%1$s"?"
"Are you sure you want to delete all profiles? This cannot be undone."
"For reliable VPN operation, disable battery optimization for Rovunet. Without this, Android may suspend the VPN when the screen is off."
"This profile contains SSH credentials. Avoid using a root account or password auth — anyone with this profile can access your server. Use a restricted user with key-based authentication instead."
"Resolver addresses will be hidden. Old app versions won't be able to import this profile."
"Device ID can be found in Settings on the target device"
"Required to decrypt the bundle on import."
"Locks each profile after bundle decryption. Leave blank to reuse the bundle password."
"Resolver addresses will be hidden. Old app versions won't be able to import this bundle."
"This bundle is password-protected. Enter the password to decrypt."
"Paste a link or WireGuard configuration. Speed is unknown until tested:"
"VLESS: REALITY / XHTTP / WebSocket • Hysteria2 • WireGuard (.conf)\nLegacy slipnet:// profiles are also supported."
"Scan this code on another device to import the profile"
"Unsupported QR code: use a supported link or WireGuard configuration"
"Background evidence only. A failed check never blocks or disconnects the VPN. This checks the proxy, not every app or TUN route."
"This configuration could not be imported. Check its format and supported version."
"This configuration needs a newer app version. Update Rovunet and try again."
"The operation timed out. Check the network and try again."
"The operation did not complete. Check your settings and local diagnostics, then try again."
"The saved database could not be opened. Its data was preserved; do not uninstall the app. Use a compatible backup or upgrade path."
"This code may contain login secrets for the included profiles. Share it only with trusted recipients."
